career_ladder.note: Sub-Inspectors of Police in Andhra Pradesh serve as foundational investigating officers and Station House Officers (SHOs) in executive police stations, or Platoon Commanders in the Andhra Pradesh Special Police (APSP) battalions. Recruitment and service conditions are regulated under the Andhra Pradesh Police (Stipendiary Cadet Trainee) Rules (G.O.Ms.No.315 Home Dept dated 13.10.1999) and the Andhra Pradesh Police Subordinate Service Rules (G.O.Ms.No.126 Home Dept). Promotion to Circle Inspector is based on departmental seniority and fitness; further progression to Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP) enters the State Police Service (APPS Group-A Gazetted), with eventual opportunity for induction into the Indian Police Service (IPS).

exam_scheme.note: The selection scheme conducted by SLPRB AP for Sub-Inspectors of Police comprises three sequential stages: (1) Preliminary Written Test (PWT) consisting of 2 objective papers of 100 marks each (3 hours duration each), serving as a qualifying screening test; (2) Physical Measurements Test (PMT) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET); and (3) Final Written Examination (FWE) consisting of 4 papers (each 3 hours duration). In the FWE, Paper I (English) and Paper II (Telugu/Urdu) are descriptive and strictly qualifying. For Post Code 11 (Civil SI), final selection is based on 400 marks from objective Paper III (Arithmetic & Reasoning, 200 marks) and Paper IV (General Studies, 200 marks). For Post Code 13 (APSP RSI), final selection is based on 300 marks (Paper III scaled to 100 marks + Paper IV scaled to 100 marks + PET 100 marks).

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors recruited by SLPRB AP are executive state police officers remunerated under the Andhra Pradesh Revised Pay Scales 2022 (AP RPS 2022 / 11th PRC), notified vide G.O.Ms.No.1, Finance (PC-TA) Department, dated 17.01.2022. Selected candidates undergo a mandatory 1-year institutional training at the Police Training College / Police Academy during which they receive a monthly stipend as prescribed by the Government. Upon successful completion of training and practical attachment, officers are appointed into the regular time scale of pay ₹44,570 – ₹1,27,480 with an entry basic pay of ₹44,570.
financial_package.pay_source_label: SLPRB AP Notification Rc.No.163/SLPRB/Rect.1/2022, Para 30 read with AP RPS 2022 G.O.Ms.No.1 Finance Dept
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on AP RPS 2022 entry basic pay of ₹44,570 with standardized project benchmark 58% Dearness Allowance (₹25,851) and HRA ranging from 8% in rural/semi-urban stations (₹3,566) to 16% in major city commissionerates like Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada (₹7,131), plus investigation/thana allowance, mobile/conveyance allowance, and monthly police uniform maintenance allowance. In-hand estimate factors in statutory deductions: 10% Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS/APGPS: ₹7,042), APGLI life insurance (~₹1,500), GIS (~₹120), Professional Tax (₹200), and income tax TDS. Cadet training period receives a government-fixed monthly stipend.
official_perks: Official government police residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA: 8% to 16% as per AP PRC 2022 categorization)
Andhra Pradesh Employees Health Scheme (EHS) providing comprehensive cashless medical treatment for officer and dependent family
Official police vehicle / motorcycle fuel and conveyance allowance for field investigation duties
Executive investigation allowance and mobile phone reimbursement
Police uniform kit allowance and monthly maintenance/washing allowance
Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS) / Andhra Pradesh Guaranteed Pension Scheme (APGPS)
Annual surrender leave / extra month's basic pay compensation in lieu of working on public holidays and emergency duties
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) within Andhra Pradesh as per state government rules
